name: shivshaashwat-foundation
description: Shivshaashwat Foundation NGO website – static site

scripts.minify:css: npx clean-css-cli -o assets/css/style.min.css assets/css/style.css && npx clean-css-cli -o assets/css/component.min.css assets/css/component.css
scripts.minify:js: npx terser assets/js/main.js -o assets/js/main.min.js -c -m && npx terser assets/js/partners-slider.js -o assets/js/partners-slider.min.js -c -m
scripts.build: npm run minify:css && npm run minify:js
